title: Recover archived WEF Data Policy roster and transformation-map members
summary: Target first-party or archived first-party member-list and transformation-map surfaces to expand the historical 30-member Data Policy roster beyond profile-by-profile discovery and validate additional cross-term carryover identities.

selection_reason: Profile-by-profile discovery has established real carryover but cannot efficiently close the WEF-described 30-member roster; archived first-party roster surfaces are now highest value.

data.target: Archived WEF Global Future Council on Data Policy member roster
data.query: archived WEF Global Future Council Data Policy members transformation map 2020 2021
data.research_question: Can an archived first-party roster or transformation-map surface recover the remaining historical members and validate cross-term matches at scale?
objectives: Search retained WEF initiative/community URLs for historical Data Policy membership.
Search indexed snapshots and Internet Archive references for WEF member-list pages.
Recover names embedded in Data Policy transformation-map artifacts or contemporaneous council publications.
Crossmatch only exact resolved people against later fixed rosters.
in_scope: Authoritative historical biographies used as corroboration
out_of_scope: Guessing missing roster members from topic expertise
selection_reason: Historical roster artifact recovery is now the highest-value way to improve denominator coverage and carryover completeness.
